Confirmed the Link prefetch semantics from the installed types:
- Default (`null`): prefetches the prerendered shell, stopping at the nearest `loading`/Suspense boundary — it "will not fetch the full tree to avoid fetching too much data."
- `true`: "prefetch the full React Server Component data for all route segments."

So the plan: wrap the related-products section in a `<Suspense>` boundary so it's a deferred segment excluded from the default prefetch, and set `prefetch` on the featured-product `<Link>` so the full route (including the deferred related products) is prefetched and ready on navigation.
